investigation.sdkInspection: The installed browser SDK unions, deduplicates and orders locator matches before evaluating the supplied callback on those elements. Its accessible-name role matcher supports aria-labelledby and name normalization, while the Stop decoder conservatively accepts direct aria-label equality only.
investigation.instrumentation: Readback state category, bounded Stop/idle/unrecognized/labelledby counts and nullable visibility/recognition/completion flags from the existing coherent read. Cleared at each read attempt and after a click so failed observations cannot reuse stale values.
investigation.privacy: No page text, control label values, URLs, credentials or tool payloads retained.
investigation.liveDiagnosticStatus: Diagnostic build installed and loaded after normal restart. Initial attempts failed during saved-chat recovery before Send. After repairing the stale restored view, a fresh Stop-after-native-read trial produced an automatic confirmed readback and same-chat continuation passed. The original unconfirmed receipt still cannot be attributed retrospectively.

recoveryProbe.validation: 119 browser tests passed. Observe, retain and Send programs remain byte-identical to baseline; baseline adapter qualification, confirmed-Send cleanup arming and resident helper digest remain unchanged. The installed diagnostic adapter can stay loaded.
recoveryProbe.causalCheck: A separate read-only view of the same saved chat initially showed the same prior state. One explicit reload restored the exact completed checkpoint reply and its original identity. The native verification browser is independently restored and remained stale; its next readiness attempt was also unsent. This establishes recoverable restored-page staleness, not loss of the remotely saved checkpoint.
recoveryProbe.repairBoundary: Allow one native reload only for an empty, normal saved tab with exactly one visible idle composer control and no visible Stop, containing exclusively known baseline replies ending at the immediate predecessor of a completed nonempty checkpoint. The predecessor's unique logical turn must be latest. Recheck ownership and page/composer state before reload, then wait for the exact checkpoint reply and reapply the complete existing recovery proof. No repeated reload, history replay, replacement chat or weakened acceptance.
recoveryProbe.repairValidation: 445 affected browser/runtime/adapter tests passed before the final positive-idle gate; 122 browser tests and source checks passed on the final gate. Independent review's inactivity finding was fixed and re-reviewed with no remaining actionable findings. Exact observe/retain/Send qualification and resident helper digest remain unchanged; no adapter replacement or restart is needed.
